# Example Brand

> One or two sentences that say what Example Brand is, who it's for, and what makes it different. Write it the way you'd want an AI assistant to describe you.

Key facts an assistant should get right: founded 20XX, based in City, serves who, pricing model, primary product names. Delete anything you can't state confidently.

## Product

- [Home](https://www.example.com/): what the product does, in one line
- [Pricing](https://www.example.com/pricing): plans and what's included
- [Features](https://www.example.com/features): the main capabilities

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://www.example.com/docs/getting-started): set up in five minutes
- [API reference](https://www.example.com/docs/api): endpoints and authentication

## Company

- [About](https://www.example.com/about): team, mission and history
- [Contact](https://www.example.com/contact): support and sales channels

## Optional

- [Blog](https://www.example.com/blog): announcements and guides
- [Changelog](https://www.example.com/changelog): release history
